descriptionChirho: To be or remain silent, referring to the basic state of not speaking or making sound, used intransitively in Qal stem.
To deliberately keep silent or hold one's peace, used intransitively in the Hifil stem to emphasize the intentional choice to remain quiet.
To cause others to be silent, to quiet or hush people, used in the causative sense of the Hifil stem.
To become calm or hushed, said of natural forces or tumultuous situations subsiding into stillness.
